title: Disney+ just lost 4K and all HDR support in parts of Europe, so you have to ask what the point of a Premium subscription is — and this is exactly why physical media is on the rise
excerpt: Disney+ has stopped streaming in 4K and HDR to some European subscribers, most likely because of a streaming patent dispute. Premium customers are going to be very unhappy, but there's no word on compensation yet.
content_html:
• Disney+ subscribers in some European countries have lost 4K and HDR support, including basic HDR10 as well as Dolby Vision
  • This appears to be the result of a court ruling, with the same kind of patent dispute being the cause of Disney+ losing Dolby Vision previously
  • Premium customers are paying more for very little advantage now, but there's no word on a refund or compensation as yet

A few months ago Disney+ removed Dolby Vision in parts of Europe after a patent court ruled against the entertainment company, although it brought Dolby back the following month. But now there's a much more serious removal: 4K and HDR10 are gone for many European customers as well as Dolby Vision, and these are pretty core things you pay for if you have Disney+ Premium.

It appears to be another patent issue. In a statement to FlatpanelsHD, The Walt Disney Company Nordic & Baltic said: "Following a recent court ruling affecting the technology we use to deliver 4K UHD and HDR, we have temporarily removed support for 4K UHD and HDR on Disney+. We are disappointed and share our customers' frustration. We are working hard to restore support as quickly as possible."

We're not sure exactly which countries are affected yet, but it doesn't include the UK (or US) — we'll update with a full list when we can, but it's likely to be the same countries affected by the Dolby Vision removal. The reported list of countries in that case was: Austria; Belgium; Germany; Denmark; Finland; France; Italy; Netherlands; Portugal; Romania; Sweden.

That isn't just frustrating. It's taken away a key reason for subscribing to the most expensive Premium plan (though you will still get Dolby Atmos and the ability to stream to four devices at the same time, and downloads on up to 10 devices).

But still, if you're paying the extra price specifically to upgrade from 1080p to 4K HDR, right now you're paying extra for nothing, there's no sign of any compensation for customers so far.

Maybe we should all go back to Blu-ray

It's no wonder that many movie fans are moving back to Blu-ray. Between price rises, digital deletion of paid-for titles and external issues such as patent disputes taking away picture quality you had access to until two days ago, it's not a great time to be solely reliant on streaming.

This current issue isn't Disney's fault. The major streaming services have all been targeted by patent owners claiming breach of their intellectual property, and this appears to be another one of those cases; if so, it'll probably be resolved relatively quickly.

But it does make me wonder about the bigger picture here, because I think streaming is in danger of losing what made it so popular as we pay ever increasing prices for what we used to get as standard.

In this particular case the loss of 4K and HDR has been imposed by an external issue. But the highest quality options have been moving upwards into the most expensive tiers for a couple of years now, so unless you pay for the premium subscriptions you don't get the best quality.

That means what used to be a one-size-fits-all offer is now much more complicated and more expensive every year. For example, I'm in the UK, where Disney+ has three plans, only one of which gives you Atmos and 4K. Netflix has three plans too, once again limiting 4K to the most expensive tier.

My previously ad-free Prime Video subscription is so stuffed with ads now it's a hilariously miserable experience with me and the kids swearing at the screen, and Dolby Vision and Atmos became paid-for upgrades two years ago.

I'd bet that if you're reading this you probably subscribe to, or use the ad-funded version of, a music streaming service; they're so convenient that looking for pirated songs is more trouble than it's worth. But can you say the same for the movie streamers?

I don't condone piracy at all. But as someone who's been reporting on digital piracy since the days when Metallica didn't know what a Napster was, I've seen piracy ebb and flow in music and in movies, and it's very clear that no matter how hard you try, no matter how much money and how many lawyers you throw at it, you cannot stop digital piracy. What you can do — what Netflix, the OG streamer, did — is offer a better alternative that makes it unappealing.

In a world where perfect digital copies of movies and TV shows are only a few clicks away, the only way to prevent people pirating is to make your product better in ways that persuade people to pay for it, or to accept the advertising that pays for it.

And to me it looks like only one of the major streamers is doing that: Apple TV+. What I'd love to see is the other streamers doing what it does. What I fear, and which is more likely, is that Apple TV is going to end up doing what they do.

  • 高级客户现在支付更多费用却几乎没有什么好处，但目前还没有关于退款或赔偿的消息

几个月前，在专利法院做出不利于杜比视界的裁决后，迪士尼+在欧洲部分地区取消了杜比视界，但在下个月又恢复了杜比视界。 但现在有一个更严重的删除：对于许多欧洲客户来说，4K 和 HDR10 以及杜比视界都消失了，如果你拥有 Disney+ Premium，这些都是你需要付费的核心内容。

这似乎是另一个专利问题。 华特迪士尼公司 Nordic & Baltic 在给 FlatpanelsHD 的一份声明中表示：“最近法院的一项裁决影响了我们用于提供 4K UHD 和 HDR 的技术，因此我们暂时取消了 Disney+ 上对 4K UHD 和 HDR 的支持。 我们很失望，并与客户一样感到沮丧。 我们正在努力尽快恢复支持。”

我们还不确定哪些国家/地区受到影响，但不包括英国（或美国）——我们将尽可能更新完整列表，但很可能是受到杜比视界删除影响的国家/地区。 据报道，该案例中的国家名单是：奥地利；比利时;德国;丹麦;芬兰;法国;意大利;荷兰;葡萄牙;罗马尼亚；瑞典。

这不仅仅是令人沮丧。 它消除了订阅最昂贵的高级计划的一个关键原因（尽管您仍然可以获得杜比全景声（Dolby Atmos）并能够同时流式传输到四台设备，并能够在最多 10 台设备上下载）。

但是，如果您专门支付额外的价格来从 1080p 升级到 4K HDR，那么现在您支付的额外费用毫无意义，到目前为止还没有迹象表明客户会得到任何补偿。

也许我们都应该回到蓝光

难怪许多影迷重新转向蓝光。 由于价格上涨、付费内容的数字删除以及专利纠纷等外部问题导致两天前您还可以访问的图像质量，现在并不是完全依赖流媒体的好时机。

当前的问题不是迪士尼的错。 主要的流媒体服务都成为专利所有者的目标，声称侵犯了其知识产权，这似乎是其中的另一起案件；如果是这样，它可能会相对较快地得到解决。

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

但这确实让我想知道这里的更大前景，因为我认为流媒体有失去它如此受欢迎的危险，因为我们为过去作为标准的东西支付了越来越高的价格。

在这种特殊情况下，4K 和 HDR 的丢失是由外部问题造成的。 但几年来，最高质量的选项已经上升到最昂贵的级别，因此，除非您支付高级订阅费用，否则您无法获得最好的质量。

这意味着过去一刀切的优惠现在变得更加复杂，而且每年都更加昂贵。 例如，我在英国，Disney+ 有三种计划，其中只有一种提供 Atmos 和 4K。 Netflix 也有三个计划，再次将 4K 限制在最昂贵的级别。

我以前没有广告的 Prime Video 订阅现在充满了广告，现在我和孩子们对着屏幕咒骂，这是一次可笑的悲惨经历，杜比视界和杜比全景声在两年前变成了付费升级。

我敢打赌，如果您正在阅读本文，您可能会订阅或使用音乐流媒体服务的广告资助版本；它们太方便了，以至于寻找盗版歌曲比它的价值更麻烦。 但你能对电影主播说同样的话吗？

我根本不容忍盗版。 但作为一个从 Metallica 还不知道 Napster 是什么的时代起就开始报道数字盗版的人，我已经看到了音乐和电影中盗版的潮起潮落，而且很明显，无论你如何努力，无论你投入多少钱和多少律师，你都无法阻止数字盗版。 你能做的——就像 OG 流媒体公司 Netflix 所做的那样——提供一个更好的替代方案，让它变得没有吸引力。

在当今世界，只需点击几下鼠标即可获得电影和电视节目的完美数字副本，防止人们盗版的唯一方法是通过说服人们付费或接受为其付费的广告来改进您的产品。

在我看来，似乎只有主要流媒体之一在这样做：Apple TV+。 我希望看到其他主播也能做同样的事情。 我担心的，也是更有可能的是，Apple TV 最终会做他们所做的事情。
